Guided dev-environment installer — yarn setup. Cross-platform (Node-only, no shell): verifies Node/Yarn/Git, installs dependencies, wires git hooks, probes the media-convert toolchain, and prints the exact next steps. Read-only checks never mutate; installs are the standard yarn + hook-copy operations.

yarn setup full guided setup yarn setup --check report only — no install/write side effects

probe

Runs a command quietly; returns its trimmed stdout or null on failure.
